farm: Once upon a time, a farmer, a boy and a girl lived in a village.

items.line: We have said, let us work together.
Pierre has said, we should start tonight.
Pierre was saying, this metal glows in the dark.
She was asking him, are you tired?
And he shouted back at her, I found it!
Mary was telling Pierre, we need more samples.
A decade after that, Marie taught at the Sorbonne.
When she was twenty four, Marie left Poland.
That winter, they worked day and night in a cold shed.
Okay, everyone, can you see the picture at the back?
The farmer adds the boy. Where is the cow?
The girl was shouting, it is in the garden!
Then the farmer told everyone, let us look in the garden.
The boy was whispering, I am scared of the dark.
And the boy says to them that he does not know.
Then the cow wandered into a muddy ditch.
The girl climbed up onto the haystack.
Early the next season, the farmer planted wheat in the dry field.
Sorry, let me move this to the next page.
The farmer answers, we will find her by sunset.
